verdict.rationale: Isaac documents the core loop. Teleoperation demonstrations captured on a physical robot can be converted for GR00T post-training, pretrained models can be refined with Isaac Lab RLPT, and a trained policy can be packaged into a portable deployment bundle for real hardware. Nothing shows fleet-wide rollout or an automated return path from deployed robots into retraining. missing for 10: fleet-scale model deployment/rollout to many robots, automated ingestion of operational fleet data (beyond teleop demos) into training, end-to-end closed-loop pipeline documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed collected robot data into model training and deploy the improved model back to the fleet

citations.quote: Capture high-quality demonstrations through teleoperation in simulation or on a physical robot, then convert the data for GR00T post-training.
Refine pretrained robot foundation models such as Isaac GR00T with Isaac RL Post Training (RLPT).
Package a policy’s compute graph and metadata into a portable deployment bundle to bring learned robot skills onto real hardware.
They’re also adaptable through post-training for specific embodiments, tasks, and environments.
